issue.description:
INIT-CP-0002 / Core Living Resource Standardization

Purpose:  
Promote stable living ARDS/SDD control-plane resources into reusable 4uentes-ards-core canon while preserving local orchestrator identity, request lifecycle ownership, and child repo adoption boundaries.

This belongs to the 4uentes-ARDS-SDD project because it governs evolution of ARDS/SDD, the Control Plane, Core, and supervised AI-driven software development governance across the stack.

Scope:

* Common governance policies: owner documentation authority/enforcement and human documentation language.
* Child-to-control-plane reconciliation link policy/template.
* Feature and bugfix state read-model.
* Initiative model.
* Orchestrator adoption review after core promotion.

Relation:

* Parent/local predecessor: INIT-CP-0001
* Related Jira Epic: SST-36
* Replaces misplaced temporary mirror: PORT-12

Boundary:

* Jira is a mirror, not ARDS/SDD source of truth.
* This Epic does not authorize direct modification of 4uentes-ards-core or child repos by itself.
* Each CR keeps its own approval, implementation boundary, validation, and evidence.

Control-plane source:

* initiatives/INIT-CP-0002-core-living-resource-standardization.yaml
* evidence/initiatives/INIT-CP-0002/core-living-resources-scope.md
